name: @openagt/skill-tickets
description: Tickets for coding agents: markdown tickets with their plans and claims, kept on a branch of the project's repository and changed with the tickets command, and the commands about them: plan, plan-tickets, triage, update-tickets and suggest-tickets-to-work-on.

scripts.build: cp ../../skills/tickets/SKILL.md SKILL.md && mkdir -p commands/plan && cp ../../skills/plan/SKILL.md commands/plan/SKILL.md && mkdir -p commands/plan-tickets && cp ../../skills/plan-tickets/SKILL.md commands/plan-tickets/SKILL.md && mkdir -p commands/triage && cp ../../skills/triage/SKILL.md commands/triage/SKILL.md && mkdir -p commands/update-tickets && cp ../../skills/update-tickets/SKILL.md commands/update-tickets/SKILL.md && mkdir -p commands/suggest-tickets-to-work-on && cp ../../skills/suggest-tickets-to-work-on/SKILL.md commands/suggest-tickets-to-work-on/SKILL.md && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build -c dashboard/vite.config.ts
scripts.prepack: node -e "if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Pack and publish with pnpm: it replaces workspace:* with the real version, npm does not');process.exit(1)}" && cp ../../skills/tickets/SKILL.md SKILL.md && mkdir -p commands/plan && cp ../../skills/plan/SKILL.md commands/plan/SKILL.md && mkdir -p commands/plan-tickets && cp ../../skills/plan-tickets/SKILL.md commands/plan-tickets/SKILL.md && mkdir -p commands/triage && cp ../../skills/triage/SKILL.md commands/triage/SKILL.md && mkdir -p commands/update-tickets && cp ../../skills/update-tickets/SKILL.md commands/update-tickets/SKILL.md && mkdir -p commands/suggest-tickets-to-work-on && cp ../../skills/suggest-tickets-to-work-on/SKILL.md commands/suggest-tickets-to-work-on/SKILL.md
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node ../../scripts/test-node.mjs && cd dashboard && vitest run
